title: Data Import ON gives access to the Imports pages
custom_preconds: 1. A user is assigned a role with Settings ON and the Data Import sub-toggle ON.
custom_steps:
1. Log in as that user.
  2. Open the Settings area and look for the Imports pages.
custom_expected: The Imports pages are available: Contacts Import, Inventory Import, Invoices Import, Vehicles Import and Vendors Import.
evidence: UI (role settingsDataImport): the IMPORTS group is present — Contacts, Assets, Vendors, Inventory, Invoices. screenshot settings-SetX.
